items.title: Special right to terminate contract due to price increase
items.quote: Sie dürfen den Vertrag deshalb innerhalb von drei Monaten nach Erhalt dieses Schreibens kostenlos und ohne Kündigungsfrist beenden, frühestens zum Wirksamwerden der Preisänderung.
items.computation: The letter gives a right to terminate without notice period within three months 'nach Erhalt' (after receipt), not from the document date itself. The letter is dated Wed 18.11.2026; the actual day it was received by the customer is not stated. Taking the document date as the earliest plausible proxy for receipt (actual receipt by post is typically a few days later): counting under §187 Abs.1 BGB the day of receipt is not counted, the period starts the next day; under §188 Abs.2 BGB a 3-month period ends on the day of the third following month bearing the same number as the start day, i.e. 18.02.2027 (a Thursday, no weekend/holiday shift needed). Because the real receipt date is unknown and could be a few days later (which would push the deadline a few days further into the future), this is the earliest plausible date and confidence is lowered. Note: termination can in any case only take effect at the earliest on 01.02.2027, the date the price increase becomes effective, as stated in the letter ('frühestens zum Wirksamwerden der Preisänderung'); that governs when the termination is effective, not the deadline for giving notice.

warnings: The three-month deadline to terminate runs from the date the letter was actually received, not from its printed date; since the actual receipt date is not stated, the due date 2027-02-18 is the earliest plausible estimate and could be a few days later if the letter arrived after 18.11.2026 — confirm the actual delivery date if exercising this right close to the deadline.
Termination under this special right can only take effect at the earliest on 01.02.2027 (when the price increase becomes effective), even if notice is given earlier.
